name: snag_spruce
form_origin: A STANDING DEAD TRUNK WITH A BROKEN TOP. break_frac 0.62 ends the leader at 62 % of its live run and TreeGrower's Broken cap closes it with an apex standing proud of a ring whose own vertices are pulled forward at random, so the fracture is jagged from every side rather than sawn. max_order 1 and order_len 0.30 leave the stubs of the first branch order and nothing above them; foliate 0 means no leaf point is emitted anywhere, so the mesh IS the plant. The remaining stubs are held by a CONICAL envelope on the declared spread, so a dead spruce keeps the outline of the live one it was rather than needing its stub length hand-tuned.
dimensions_origin: [SET] from the mature open-grown band a European field guide gives the species; no measurement of an individual is claimed and every one is falsifiable against a photograph with a scale in it.
dbh_cm_origin: the diameter of the dead stem at 1.3 m where the form reaches it; 0 where it does not, and base_radius stands as declared.
lai_origin: 0: foliate is 0, the form carries no leaf at all and no card is grown.
bark_origin: sRGB. Dead spruce bark is grey-brown and flaking off in plates; the high ridge is the plate edge and the low bark_dark is the shadow under a lifted plate.
